headline: 西班牙尋骸紀錄片登場
context: 西班牙導演曼努葉．柯瑞亞（Manuel Correa）的紀錄片《消失的地圖》，記錄三個家庭尋找親人遺骸的過程——這些人是佛朗哥獨裁政權時期遭處決，遺體被祕密藏進「烈士谷」（Valle de los Caídos）紀念碑地下墓穴的受害者，如今研究團隊靠科技協助辨識與尋回。另一本新書《八月政變》，則回顧了1991年8月，蘇聯政權僅3天內迅速瓦解的過程。

sources.name: The Guardian
sources.summary: Researchers employ technology in a bid to identify and retrieve remains in Spain’s Valley of the Fallen, in Manuel Correa’s emotional documentary Perched on the Sierra de Guadarrama mountain range overlooking Madrid is the Valle de los Caídos , a colossal memorial site constructed under the Franco regime. Supposedly a symbol of atonement and reconciliation, it has been criticised as an emblem of fascist glorification; it was where Franco was buried until his exhumation in 2019 . There are, however, tens of thousands more bodies are trapped inside; in the aftermath of the White Terror, the corpses of those executed under the dictatorship were clandestinely removed from mass graves and deposited in the monument’s crypt. Both thought-provoking and heartwrenching, Manuel Correa’s documentary follows three grieving families and their fight to rescue their loved ones from this horrifying limbo. Here, architecture emerges as a means of oppression. Through examining various construction blueprints, the film lays bare how the crypt was specifically designed for maximum inaccessibility. The bodies of the victims were meant to languish, hidden away, in perpetuity, as does the evidence of the dictatorship’s barbarity. To combat these efforts to bury history, Correa founded the Office of Documentary Research, where activists, geographers, and architects wade through the fog of secrecy with state-of-the-art technology. sources.name: The Guardian
sources.summary: This brilliant account of attempts by the old guard to take back control captures the ludicrousness of it all beautifully Marxist-Leninist rule in Russia lasted 74 years, and in August 1991 it effectively collapsed in just three days: clear evidence of how hollowed out it had become. In the period that followed, Russia tried parliamentary democracy and unalloyed capitalism, then sank back into autocracy. Now it’s struggling under a wholly unnecessary war against its neighbour and former possession, Ukraine. Why did the system of Lenin, Stalin, Khrushchev and Brezhnev vanish so fast, without a fight? Because that’s how regimes fall in Russia: look at tsarism in 1917. (It almost happened again in June 2023, when the warlord Yevgeny Prigozhin’s men marched on Moscow largely unopposed; Vladimir Putin might have gone the way of Nicholas II had he not made some pretty wholesale promises to Prigozhin, then allegedly blown him up two months later.) threads_text:
西班牙導演曼努葉．柯瑞亞（Manuel Correa）的紀錄片《消失的地圖》，跟拍三個家庭尋找親人遺骸的過程。這些人是佛朗哥獨裁政權時期遭處決的受害者，遺體當年被祕密藏進「烈士谷」（Valle de los Caídos）紀念碑的地下墓穴，如今研究團隊靠建築藍圖分析與現代技術，試圖找出遺骸的確切位置。另一本新書《八月政變》，作者羅伯特．瑟維斯（Robert Service）回顧1991年8月，蘇聯政權在短短3天內迅速瓦解的過程，也點出俄羅斯政權更迭往往來得又快又突然的歷史模式。

本則來自 The Guardian，2026 年 8 月 3 日發佈的報導。
voice_text: 西班牙有一部新紀錄片，叫《消失的地圖》，跟拍三個家庭尋找親人遺骸的過程。這些人是佛朗哥獨裁時期遭處決的受害者，遺體當年被祕密藏進一座紀念碑的地下墓穴，研究團隊現在靠科技協助，試著把他們找出來。同一份書評版面，也提到一本新書《八月政變》，回顧1991年蘇聯政權，在短短3天內迅速瓦解的過程。
